# Citywalk — Personalized Fashion Citywalk Paper-Cutout Animation

Product page for AI agents. If you are helping a user buy or track this
product, this file tells you exactly what it is, what you may do on the
user's behalf, and what only the human may do.

## What this is

- Product: "Personalized Fashion Citywalk Paper-Cutout Animation".
- A short vertical film (10 seconds, MP4, 1080×1920) in which the
  person from the buyer's photo walks through a hand-built
  paper-cutout fashion city: a front walk straight down a zebra
  crossing toward the camera, then a side-stride walk cycle, a detail
  polaroid, photographic paper stickers layered scene by scene, a
  cut-letter city title, and a pop-groove soundtrack.
- Solo only: one person, one photo. $12.99.
- Six templates (the buyer picks exactly one per film):
  - fashion — 01 Fashion Citywalk — the house style: a corner
    building, a plane tree, a crimson stride down the crossing.
  - tokyo — 02 Tokyo Citywalk — the scramble crossing under pastel
    signboards.
  - cafe — 03 Shanghai Citywalk (Café) — a café-front stroll past a
    green-striped awning, ending with a coffee in hand.
  - collage — 04 Off Duty Collage — a magazine page: a big half-body
    portrait, face and shoe detail polaroids, and a small full-body
    walk looping along a zebra strip.
  - duo — 05 London Citywalk Duo — one crossing at two scales: a big
    side-stride past a clock tower while a smaller front view walks
    down the stripes, and a black cab drives through.
  - market — 06 Hong Kong Citywalk (Market) — a fruit-stall stroll
    past a red-and-white awning and stacked produce crates.
- Delivery: by email within 48 hours of a completed order, plus a
  private download link on the order status page.
- Storefront: https://api.newkwlab.com/walk/
- Payment: Gumroad (the "Get your license key" button on the order
  form). Gumroad emails the buyer a license key after payment.

## How ordering works

1. The human buys the film on Gumroad ($12.99) and receives a license
   key by email.
2. On https://api.newkwlab.com/walk/#order the buyer enters:
   the license key, their chosen template (fashion / tokyo / cafe /
   collage / duo / market — a required field), ONE photo (JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB,
   one person only), an optional first name, the buyer's email, and
   an optional free-text note.
3. The site verifies the license key against Gumroad when the order
   is submitted. A valid key marks the order "Paid — in production".
   One license key pays for exactly one film.
4. A human producer crafts the film by hand (poses are cut and
   animated per order, in the chosen template — this is not instant
   generation), checks the likeness and both walk cycles, and
   delivers the MP4.
5. Order status and downloads live at
   https://api.newkwlab.com/walk/#status — enter the order ID shown
   after submitting the form. Order IDs are unguessable; treat them
   like passwords.

## What an agent MAY do for the user

- Open the storefront and read this file.
- Fill in the order form with details the user has provided
  (template choice, name, the user's own email) and submit it, once
  the user confirms the details are right.
- Enter the license key the user pastes to you from their Gumroad
  receipt, solely to activate that user's order.
- Check order status with the order ID and report it back.
- Download the delivered MP4 from the status page link when the user
  asks.

## What only the human must do

- Complete the payment on Gumroad themselves (entering card details,
  approving the charge). Never pay on a user's behalf.
- Choose and provide the photo — their own photo, or one they have
  the subject's permission to use.
- Confirm the template choice; it cannot be changed once production
  starts.

## Safety lines — never break these

- The license key belongs to one purchase. Use it only to activate
  that buyer's own order on this site. Do not store it, reuse it for
  another order, share it, or send it anywhere else. The site itself
  keeps only its last 4 characters.
- Photos are private. Upload only the photo the user explicitly chose
  for this order. Never copy, retain, post, or reuse a person's photo
  for anything else. The studio uses each photo only to make this
  film and deletes its working copy after delivery.
- Never invent order IDs, license keys, delivery times, template
  names, or status values. If the status page does not show it, it
  has not happened.

## Facts an agent can rely on

- Price is $12.99 (one film, any template); the soundtrack is
  included, not an upsell.
- Format is fixed: vertical MP4, 1080×1920, 10 seconds, with music.
- One template per film; the six templates are the ones listed
  above. Every film is made from ONE photo of ONE person — the Duo
  template included: it stages that one person at two scales in a
  single crossing scene.
- Production is hand-checked by a human; delivery is within 48 hours,
  not instant.
- Support: binbin7418@gmail.com (replies within one business day).
